tooltip.charter.cursed: Bound to %s: nobody else can hold it
tooltip.charter.charter_contract.1: Use it on a player who crouches to draw up a contract.
tooltip.charter.charter_contract.2: You become its creator and they become its signer.
tooltip.charter.charter_contract.3: The signer can never harm you.
tooltip.charter.charter_contract.4: Crouch and use it twice to sign with Charter itself.
tooltip.charter.signed_contract.creator: Drawn up by %s
Strike the signer with a sword in your off hand to take an arm.
Use it with a Charter weapon in your off hand to curse the weapon.
Crouch and use it twice to release the signer.
tooltip.charter.signed_contract.signer.2: Crouch and use it twice to break it. Every break costs a part of your body.
tooltip.charter.lesser_divinity.1: A golden sigil, then a beam. All inside are banned.
tooltip.charter.fractured_lesser_divinit: Casts its victims out instead of banning them.
The exiled cannot die until they near home.
tooltip.charter.dusk_epitaph.1: A fully charged blow against a player
tooltip.charter.dusk_epitaph.2: summons golden chains. They are banned.
tooltip.charter.dusk_epitaph.contract: Answers only to those bound to Charter.
tooltip.charter.dusk_epitaph.3: Against anything else, only a heavy blade.
tooltip.charter.divine_dominance.1: Place it to raise a golden cage.
tooltip.charter.divine_dominance.2: It starts %s blocks wide, then closes in.
tooltip.charter.divine_dominance.3: Only its owner and the bound may cross.
tooltip.charter.divine_dominance.4: When the walls meet, Charter judges whoever is left.
death.attack.charter.judgement.player: %1$s was judged by Charter while fighting %2$s
death.attack.charter.judgement.item: %1$s was judged by Charter at the hand of %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.charter.crush.player: %1$s was crushed between golden walls while fighting %2$s
death.attack.charter.crush.item: %1$s was crushed between golden walls by %2$s using %3$s
